# outputs/spatial_analysis/ — Spatial Diagnostics

Gridded / map-based analyses (composites, trends, EOF, correlation, etc.) beyond regional-mean timeseries.

## Purpose

Explore spatial structure of SST anomalies and MHW-related fields (partial completion depending on stage).

## On-disk layout

```
outputs/spatial_analysis/spatial_analysis/
├── anomalies/ composites/ correlation/ density/
├── difference_maps/ eof/ lead_lag/
├── mann_kendall/ sens_slope/ trend/
├── csv/ netcdf/ figures/ logs/
```

## Generated by

Primarily `src/climate/scripts/enso_spatial_analysis.py` and related spatial tooling (see script headers). Some stages may be incomplete.

## Upstream / Downstream

Merged SST cube + catalogues / climate indices → spatial NetCDF/figures → exploratory science (not required for tabular ML v1).

## Notes

Treat as research workspace; confirm which subfolders are populated before citing results.
